title: Exoprimal shuts down for good in September 2027 🦖
subject: exoprimal
description:
Did you ever play Exoprimal? 👇

Capcom announced on November 25, 2026 that Exoprimal's service ends at 8:00 PM PDT on September 29, 2027, after which the game will no longer be playable. Survival Pass Premium Tiers left stores on November 24, 2026, and the game and all DLC will be removed from stores on March 30, 2027. Owners can re-download it until the end of service. Exoprimal launched July 14, 2023 on PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One and PC.

Sources: Capcom official Exoprimal End of Service Announcement (Nov 25, 2026), TheGamer (Nov 25, 2026)
Game footage/images © CAPCOM.

scenes.text: Capcom is pulling the plug on Exoprimal.
On November 25, Capcom said the dinosaur shooter's servers go dark on September 29, 2027.
After that, Exoprimal can't be played at all, on PlayStation, Xbox or PC.
Its season passes are already off sale. The game and every DLC leave stores on March 30, 2027.
Owners can still re-download it until September. Exoprimal launched on July 14, 2023, so it will have lasted just over four years.
